rationale: Price is at 99.3% of today's range, essentially at the session high of $22.26, with the last candle showing a slight pullback from that high on declining volume — this is an extremely extended position with minimal reward-to-risk for a long entry. A short at the high is tempting given the exhaustion signals (tiny-bodied candles, volume tapering), but the 5-minute ATR is only $0.085, the spread is tight, and with 197 minutes remaining and strong upward momentum (price well above VWAP at $21.54 and above the 9-EMA at $22.06), a breakout continuation is equally plausible, making the risk/reward insufficient in either direction to justify a position.
